    The common reduced-word Hilbert space for Boca's dilation #

    The empty word carries the original Hilbert space. A singleton word carries the defect of the corresponding input POVM, while deeper words carry the defect of scalar evaluation at the distinguished coordinate. Splitting by a fixed head letter and pairing equal tails identifies the whole space with an lp-sum of full finite Naimark spaces.
